anthropic-copilot.walkthrough.title: Anthropic Claude for Copilot Chat
anthropic-copilot.walkthrough.descriptio: Set up Anthropic Claude models in Copilot Chat.
[Get an API key](command:anthropic-copilot.getApiKey) from anthropic.com.
[Set API Key](command:anthropic-copilot.setApiKey)
anthropic-copilot.walkthrough.showModels:
If the models are hidden, open VS Code's Language Models manager and show the Anthropic models.
[Open Language Models](command:workbench.action.chat.manage)
anthropic-copilot.walkthrough.advancedSe:
Customize providers, Base URL, and model names in the extension settings.
[Open settings](command:anthropic-copilot.openSettings)
anthropic-copilot.config.title: Anthropic Copilot
anthropic-copilot.config.apiKey.descript: Anthropic API Key or Auth Token. (Alternatively set via Command Palette or SecretStorage).
anthropic-copilot.config.baseUrl.descrip: Anthropic API base URL. Defaults to https://api.anthropic.com.
anthropic-copilot.config.maxTokens.descr: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use API default.
anthropic-copilot.config.experimental.st: **Experimental**: Pre-activate available tools list to stabilize tool schemas across turns.
anthropic-copilot.config.debugMode.descr: Controls diagnostic information logged by Anthropic Copilot.
anthropic-copilot.config.modelIdOverride: Override the API model ID sent for each Anthropic model.
anthropic-copilot.config.customModels.de: Define additional custom Anthropic/Claude models with custom display names to expose in Copilot Chat.
anthropic-copilot.config.visionModel.des: Vision Proxy used when native image input is unavailable.
anthropic-copilot.config.customHeaders.d: Custom HTTP headers included with every Anthropic API request (e.g. for proxy gateways like LiteLLM/CC-Switch).
